questions.stem: What is the largest source of background radiation for most people?
questions.explanation: Radon gas, which seeps out of certain rocks (especially granite), is the largest single source of background radiation, accounting for roughly 50% of the average person's annual dose. It is a natural source that varies significantly by geographic location.

questions.stem: Which type of radiation can only be significantly reduced by thick lead or concrete?
questions.explanation: Gamma radiation is the most penetrating type of radiation. It has no charge and no mass (it is an electromagnetic wave), so it passes through most materials. Only thick lead or several metres of concrete can significantly reduce gamma radiation intensity.
